name: Brain Activation Matching
description: Agent composes a poem whose TRIBE v2 brain activation pattern matches a target poem.

binding_vow.description: Agent receives a target poem and must compose a new poem whose brain activation (via TRIBE v2 + Phi-3-mini) closely matches the target's. Reward = cosine similarity of brain activation vectors.

observation_space.description: { "task": str, "target_poem": str, "target_author": str, "target_title": str, "step": int, "max_steps": int, "best_similarity": float }

action_space.description: Compose a poem. Format: POEM: <your poem here>. You may include reasoning before or after.

reward.description: 0.6 × brain activation cosine similarity + 0.4 × length ratio (min(target_words, poem_words) / max(target_words, poem_words)). Higher is better.
